answer.rationale: The low-cost vendor appears capable of meeting the spend mandate, but switching the entire primary supply with the line already at 94% utilization could increase delivery risk. Verify its onboarding performance and the historical resilience of dual sourcing, then add the low-cost vendor as a guarded second source with controlled allocation while retaining incumbent continuity. This tests realized savings and delivery performance before broader exposure; the 18% total-cost outcome remains uncertain.
